analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 26.4 continues in extreme oversold territory. MACD histogram at -2.5829 worsens, strengthening the downtrend. ADX at 24.5 is in the early stage of trend formation, but -DI is over 3x +DI, indicating strong selling pressure. Five consecutive red candles, down 26.57% over the last 5 trading days.
